instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\profile_seed.dxf. Import profile_seed.dxf. Draw a closed symmetric notched profile through vertices (0,0), (160,0), (160,40), (105,40), (105,70), (55,70), (55,40), and (0,40). Add CENTER symmetry line from (80,0) to (80,70), two radius 5 holes at (30,20) and (130,20), and text ACAD-28. Use OUTLINE for the notched profile, CENTER for the symmetry line, HOLE for holes, and ANNOTATION for text. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. [Software] Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.
